name: TSC Auto ID Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: TSC Auto ID Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 1991 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the design, production, and global distribution of barcode printers and their associated peripheral accessories. The company's core focus is serving clients within the automatic identification (auto-ID) system industry worldwide. Its extensive product range encompasses a diverse selection of printers, including desktop, industrial, enterprise, and mobile models. TSC Auto ID also provides various print engines and modules, color label printers, barcode inspection tools, RFID solutions, and keyboards. Furthermore, they offer complementary software solutions and a wide array of labeling options, from standard stock to custom designs, along with thermal printing supplies. The company's solutions cater to a broad spectrum of industries globally, such as medical, retail, transportation, warehousing, logistics, manufacturing, entertainment, hospitality, healthcare, cannabis, food and beverage, and automotive sectors.
